audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Wimmer axioms do not imply near-zero EU for endpoint mixture; True-parameter consistency is transferred outside its representability conditions; Task mixture omits context conditioning.
limitations: F1 — Wimmer axioms do not imply near-zero EU for endpoint mixture — Counterevidence: Wimmer discusses knowledge-versus-disagreement intuition, but does not derive near-zero. No claim to construct metric satisfying inconsistent full axioms.

F2 — True-parameter consistency is transferred outside its representability conditions — Counterevidence: Selected-model entropy definition is genuinely different; class-restricted Bayes predictor terminology is legitimate. Neither justifies the forced classification of all residual misspecification bias.
F3 — Task mixture omits context conditioning — Counterevidence: Notation may suppressx; task could be made sufficient, but neither is stated. Surroundingtextacknowledgescontext.
